facts.fact: UNICEF and the national water authority ANDEA, with the Ministry of Water, run a drought monitoring system for southern Madagascar based on satellite NDVI anomalies and rainfall, whose issue 62 of June 2024 reports 30.1% of the territory on Alarm.
facts.system: Systeme de monitoring de la secheresse (SMS)

facts.fact: UNICEF and ANDEA say a monthly drought alert bulletin from the monitoring system is distributed to all stakeholders in Madagascar; issue 62 is dated June 2024.
facts.system: Bulletin de monitoring de la secheresse

systems.system: Systeme de monitoring de la secheresse (SMS)
systems.owner: UNICEF, ANDEA, Ministry of Water, Energy and Hydrocarbons
